entries.content:
Description: A clan of spirit channelers who live in the mountains. They are famous for the "kurain channeling technique", but struggle to make ends meet monetarily. Only the women are allowed to undergo spiritual training, and men are typically not allowed to observe.

Notable members: Maya Fey, Pearl Fey, Misty Fey, Iris, Morgan Fey, Mia Fey.

Description: A spirit channeling technique that is unique to the Fey Clan. When channeling a spirit with this technique, the medium assumes the body form and mind of the spirit, though their hair and clothing remains that of the medium. Men are strictly unable to use this technique.

Notable users: Maya Fey, Pearl Fey, Mia Fey.
Description: A village in the mountains that is home to the Fey Clan. Has a bus stop, a few shrines, and the Fey Clan's meager estate.

The murder of Gregory Edgeworth perpetrated by the prosecutor Manfred von Karma. Infamous for its use of a spirit medium to identify the culprit incorrectly. The medium involved was Misty Fey, who vanished in disgrace after the use of a medium was leaked to the press. The truth came to light about this case a few years ago.

Description: A popular superhero show featuring a robotic samurai as its protagonist, and the "Evil Magistrate" as its antagonist.

Quotes: "It is you who should gaze upon the moon, for it will be your last! See you in hell, evil magistrate!!"

Description: The legal system in this country is that of the Japanese bench trial. The Prosecuting Attorney and Defense Attorney each argue their case to a judge, with the burden of proof for the murder lying with the prosecutor. Nearly every trial in the country results in a guilty verdict as a result of extreme pressure upon prosecutors to produce results. Defense attorneys are seen as scumbags, with a few exceptions. Each trial lasts 3 days at most, with sentencing being at a follow-up hearing.

Description: A group of spiritually-sensitive individuals with the power to communicate with and channel spirits. Some people possess more spiritual power than others, but it requires extreme levels of training in order to channel individuals who are not personally connected to the medium themselves. Only women can be spirit mediums.

Notable members: Maya Fey, Pearl Fey, Mia Fey.

Description: An attorney working for the government whose duties are to coordinate police investigations, and then determine if an indictment should be delivered to any particular suspect for trial. During trial, their duties are to present their case as to why the defendant is guilty.

Description: A family infamous in the legal world for their ruthless and perfection-seeking prosecutors. Outside of the legal world, however, they are basically unknown, and many members of the bloodline are not involved with the legal world.

Notable members: Manfred von Karma, Franziska von Karma, an unnamed sister of Franziska's.

Description: An infamous senior prosecutor with a flawless record up until his conviction for murder. Father of Franziska von Karma, and adoptive father of Miles Edgeworth. Murderer of Gregory Edgeworth and the mastermind behind the DL-6 incident. Known for his commanding presence and demands for utter perfection. Surprisingly caring parent, despite his stern nature.

The Wright Anything Agency is an organization that is a mix of talent agency and law office. They are extremely small and tight-knit, with their owner Trucy Wright being the only "talent", and the lawyers consisting of four members: Phoenix Wright, Apollo Justice, and Athena Cykes. Previously, the Wright Anything agency was known as the "Wright & Co. Law Offices", before Phoenix Wright's adoptive daughter Trucy Wright took over the office.

Their offices are absolutely cluttered to the brim with magic show props, a single desk to work at, and a couch to lounge on.

A group dedicated to whistleblowing through stealing evidence of scandals and then leaking it to the media and police. The public isn't aware it is a group, and believes it to be a single person.
Members include: Byrne Faraday, Yew Calisto, and Tyrell Badd.
Kay's deceased father. Byrne was a prosecutor who was murdered many years ago under suspicious circumstances by Yew Calisto. Yew Calisto escaped punishment and vanished.

Troupe Gramarye were a legendary magician's troupe formed by Magnifi Gramarye, and almost entirely staffed by his children and their spouses. Was disbanded after Magnifi was murdered, Zak Gramarye was blamed for the crime, and Thalassa Gramarye disappeared.
Notable members: Magnifi Gramarye, Valant Gramarye, Thalassa Gramarye, Zak Gramarye, Mr. Reus.
A wooden puppet belonging to Trucy Wright. Can be unfolded into place from behind Trucy's cape, and is controlled by controls located in Trucy's fanny pack.
An act wherein Trucy Wright pulls large objects out of a pair of blue bloomers. Trucy enjoys making reference to these in a way that embarrasses people.

Defense Attorneys are generally private-practice attorneys hired by clients to defend them in Japanifornian court. They have a bad reputation of being immoral scumbags, with Wright Anything Agency members being notable exceptions to that reputation.

Phoenix Wright is a semi-legendary defense attorney based in Japanifornia. After his mentor, Mia Fey, was murdered, he defended her little sister in court and became wrapped up in a long saga that eventually saw him exposing the true culprit of the DL-6 incident and its ramifications.
He was eventually disbarred for alleged forgery of evidence, and reinstated quietly many years later. 
Has an adoptive daughter named Trucy Wright.
